events.text: The building was granted to the Daughters of the American Revolution.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1913 , the building was granted to the Daughters of the American Revolution

events.text: The building served as the army headquarters of General Leonard Wood and the United States Lighthouse Service in World War I.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In World War I , the building served as the army headquarters of General Leonard Wood

events.text: The building served as a USO facility and canteen for troops and as the Coastal Picket Station for the Sixth Naval District in World War II.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In World War II , the building not only served as a USO facility and canteen for troops
